title: Object.duplicate() can crash game without error when queue_free'ing a referenced node in _ready()
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
-Hangs instead of crashes when similar code executed in v3.6.1.stable.official[b1ba98fce]

### System information

linuxbsd build x86_64 on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS

### Issue description

Calling duplicate() on a node from _process is crashing the game under certain circumstances.  Specifically, duplicating a node which itself calls queue_free on a non-null object in its _ready().

The game crashes, but not the editor.  No error messages are given.  Possibly related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/3393 although no crash is reported in that report.  I can work around the issue in my current project by using instantiate, or calling duplicate in _ready()

### Steps to reproduce

duplicate an object during a _process call, then add it to the scene in a call_deferred.  The duplicated object calls queue_free on an @export reference in its _ready, after confirming that the reference is not null.  

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

mrp4.zip has a 4.4.1 project that crashes when the duplicate occurs, and matches the stacktrace above
mrp3.zip has a 3.6.1 project that hangs when the duplicate occurs.
